gloss: to value, to prize, to revere

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {尊|とうと}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to value, to prize, to hold in high regard
definitions.explanation: To consider something important and treat it with respect. Used for abstract values, principles, and things worthy of respect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}ぶ。
⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}ぶ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: A culture that values tradition remains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}び、⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should value peace and avoid conflict.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat formal word. Used for abstract concepts like life, peace, tradition, freedom, and human rights. Common in speeches, essays, and formal writing.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
The same kanji {尊|たっと}ぶ can also be read たっとぶ with the same meaning. Both readings are standard.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧: to treat with care (more everyday)
- ⟦{重|おも}んじる→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧: to attach importance to (formal)
- ⟦{敬|うやま}う→敬う：00417_uyamau⟧: to respect, to revere (focuses more on people)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}ぶ: to value life
- ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}ぶ: to value peace
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}ぶ: to value freedom
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}ぶ: to value tradition
- ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尊|とうと}ぶ: to value human rights
